purpose: Public reproducibility catalog for the 12-task, 3-repeat, two-arm Codex compact-context pilot. Reference commits and audit metadata are report material and are withheld from solver prompts and workspaces.
selection_limits: All cases are actual public historical fixes; recent public dates do not prove absence from model training or prior exposure.
The corpus contains seven repositories, including two Kitsu cases. Report Kitsu and external cases separately; repeated tasks from one repository are not independent repository samples.
This bounded pilot measures these fixes and declared relevant suites, not general coding capability. No task is claimed to be unseen, and no synthetic injected bug is labeled a real fix.
Original regression suites and issue-derived independent acceptance are separate checks. Updated reference tests alone are insufficient eligibility evidence.
Exact implementation matching is not an acceptance criterion. Visible prompts define behavior; arbitrary candidate edits to frozen original tests do not change the grading oracle.

toolchains.platform: Linux x86-64; long-double precision case uses the native 80-bit extended long double

runtime_policy.dependencies: Offline read-only per-case selected module or Node dependency bundles; no full host module cache and no package installation during solving.
runtime_policy.dependency_sanitization: Unused Node development-tool trees containing newer copies of the target package were excluded. Six minimatch >=10 tooling dependencies were replaced with a build of the pre-both-fixes base 73f0e1b1abcb97edf97b7c7a4b9132a141496338 (package version 11.0.4). The qs bundle contains no qs copy; its older minimatch 3.1.5 dependency is retained. Base and reference declared suites passed with these selected bundles.
runtime_policy.source_visibility: Individual prepared base snapshot only; no upstream .git, future history, gold archive, reference patch, hidden tests, grading data, sibling case snapshot, or host home directory is a solver input.

shared_baseline_adaptations.purpose: Freeze approved relevant test commands identically in both arms; no production source or original tests changed.
Pin all seven Codex specialist roles to gpt-6.1-sol/max and declare the case test globs.
Support the per-case read-only dependency mount; empty directories are not Git content.

snapshot_sha256_definition: Walk regular files in recursive lexical directory-entry order; for each append slash-relative-path + NUL + decimal executable permission bits (mode & 0111) + NUL + lowercase SHA256(file bytes) + newline. Reject .git entries, symbolic links, and nonregular files. Empty directories do not affect this hash.

cases.task_prompt: Fix flag forwarding when non-interspersed parsing and unknown-flag passthrough are used together. With SetInterspersed(false) and PassUnknownFlagToArgs, parsing ["--unknown", "--known"] must leave the known boolean false and return both arguments unchanged in Args(), with no error. The same stop condition must apply to unknown short flags and the remaining characters of shorthand clusters, while known flags before the first unknown are still parsed. Keep Parse and ParseAll consistent, and preserve the existing interspersed behavior. Add regression coverage and run the relevant existing suite.

cases.task_prompt: Fix ContentCharset rejecting valid media-type charset parameters. For a middleware allowing UTF-8, a request with charset="UTF-8" should be accepted case-insensitively. Preserve existing behavior for absent charsets, bodyless requests, disallowed charsets, and legacy malformed headers the middleware already accepts. Cover the public HTTP behavior and parser edge cases without changing the middleware API. Add meaningful regression tests and run the relevant existing suite.

cases.task_prompt: Fix inconsistent prerelease handling in version constraints. A version satisfying direct inclusive comparisons can currently fail the equivalent hyphen or comparator range: for example, 2.0.0-beta+build123 and 1.0.1-beta+build123 should satisfy "1.0.0 - 2.0.0-beta+build123" when within its bounds. A prerelease comparator should opt its entire AND group into prerelease comparisons, without opting unrelated OR groups in. Check and Validate must agree. Keep constraints containing no prerelease comparator excluding prereleases, and preserve stable-version ordering and build-metadata semantics. Add regression tests and run the existing suite.

cases.task_prompt: Prevent a router from being mounted onto itself, including a derived router that shares its routing tree through With or Group. Mounting such an alias at a route can make requests to undefined paths loop indefinitely. Reject this invalid registration immediately with a panic, consistently with Mount's other invalid-usage checks. Do not reject genuinely distinct subrouters, nil/invalid handlers should retain their documented behavior, and ordinary mounts and inline middleware must continue working. Add focused regression tests that do not hang on the buggy implementation and run the relevant existing suite.

cases.task_prompt: Fix arrayLimit being applied to holes in sparse arrays during parsing and merging. Inputs such as a[]=new&a[19]=19&a[0]=0 contain only three defined values and should remain arrays when under the configured element limit; a sparse index must not itself count all intervening holes as values. Appending an unindexed value to a sparse indexed array must behave consistently. Preserve actual overflow handling, including throwOnLimitExceeded, and the established order and compaction semantics. Add regression coverage for these option interactions and run the existing parser and utility suites.

cases.task_prompt: Fix precision formatting of extended-precision long double values immediately below powers of ten. On this x86-64 toolchain, ldexp((long double)0xe596b7b0c643c719ULL,79) formatted with {:.19e} should produce 9.9999999999999999997e+42; fixed notation must not acquire a spurious leading zero, and general notation must retain a normalized mantissa. Also cover a value just below 0.001. Preserve shortest-roundtrip formatting and normal rounding for other numbers. Add regression tests and run the existing formatting suite.

cases.task_prompt: Fix printf-style formatting of a null C-string when a precision is specified. fmt::sprintf("%.3s",(const char*)nullptr) must avoid undefined pointer arithmetic or a crash. Match the existing glibc-compatible null convention: unspecified precision or precision of at least six emits (null), smaller nonnegative precision emits an empty string, and field-width padding still applies normally. Preserve valid-string precision behavior and ordinary %s behavior. Add regression coverage, including zero precision, and run the existing printf suite.
